description: Saved follow-ups: the follow-ups drafted on the Jira pages (Copy to follow-up → Save), kept in DuckDB on this PC (desktop/lib/followups.js). A list on the left; the chosen one on the right as the email that was composed. The Messages tab keeps the messages the Copy to follow-up dialog offers: yours, and your versions of the built-ins, in your order.

available.description: Follow-ups run only in the desktop app (DuckDB on this PC).

selId.description: The follow-up open on the right ('' when none).

detail.description: The open follow-up with its header and lines.

tab.description: 'saved' (the saved follow-ups) or 'messages' (the messages the follow-up dialog offers).

msgs.description: Every message the follow-up dialog can offer, hidden ones too (resources/js/followup.js merge).

msgKey.description: The message open in the editor ('' for a new one).

msgEdit.description: The message being edited: { key, label, subject, body, show, builtin, edited, mine, isNew, original }.

msgDirty.description: The editor has changes not saved yet.

focusRequest.description: Another screen opened Follow-ups on a tab (shellBus.focus('followups', { tab: 'messages' })).
